meta.name: solit2-test-protocol
meta.notes: The SOLIT2 Annex 7 full-scale test, as a runnable design. Annex 7 5.2.7 mandates that BOTH 1.5 m/s and 3.0 m/s longitudinal velocity be tested, measured 45 m upstream of the fire, so both are carried in `ventilation.velocity_range_ms` and the envelope runs the pair. A velocity range is a property of the test being run, not of the tunnel, which is why it lives here and not in the tunnel preset. Replace the `nozzles` and `hydraulics` blocks with the system actually under test; everything else is the standard's own test condition.
